Data is from: https://github.com/mcnakhaee/palmerpenguins

This post demonstrates how Python code runs in Quarto.

```{python}
import pandas as pd
from palmerpenguins import load_penguins

# Load the dataset as a pandas DataFrame
penguins = load_penguins()

# Inspect the first few rows
print(penguins.head())
```

```{python}
# Quick summary
penguins.describe()
```


Self-defined question 1:
Group by sex and island, investigate that if the plunguins' body mass are significant different between the male and female.

```{python}
df = penguins.groupby(['sex', 'island']).agg({'body_mass_g': 'mean'})
df
```

```{python}
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
ax = df.unstack()['body_mass_g'].plot(kind='bar', figsize=(8, 5))
plt.title("Mean Body Mass by Sex and Island")
plt.ylabel("Mean Body Mass (g)")
plt.xlabel("Sex")
plt.xticks(rotation=0)
plt.legend(title="Island")
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```


According to above figure, male penguins are generally having higher body mass. Also penguins on Biscoe island are significantly larger than others.
